n01-open
Every Azure conversation starts the same way. Someone describes what they need, <break time='200ms'/> and someone else has to turn it into an architecture.
n02-promise
With the Azure Architecture Diagram Builder, that takes one prompt.
n03-dialog
Open Generate Diagram. Describe the workload in plain language, the way the customer would say it, <break time='150ms'/> or start from one of the ready-made examples.
n04-brief

Here, a retailer getting ready for its biggest sales weekend: a storefront that scales, product search with AI recommendations, an order pipeline that never loses an order, <break time='100ms'/> and fraud checks in real time.
n05-model
Choose the model, and how hard it should think: <break time='120ms'/> quick for a first draft, deeper reasoning for a production design.
n06-gen
One click. AADB picks the Azure services, connects them, groups them by tier, and lays out the diagram.
n07-tour

Every node is a real Azure service with its official icon. Zoom into any group: the edge, the application tier, data, integration, security and monitoring. <break time='150ms'/> Every connection says what flows across it.
n07b-yours
Then make it yours. <break time='120ms'/> Drag any service or group wherever you like, tidy the layout, change the style. <break time='120ms'/> The connections follow, and nothing gets lost.
n08-workflow
The workflow panel walks through the design step by step, in the order a request actually travels.
n09-cost
And the monthly run rate is already there, priced from Azure retail prices for the region you pick.
n10-close
One prompt. A grouped, connected, priced Azure architecture, <break time='150ms'/> ready to validate, refine and deploy.
